tasks.title: Worktree merge preflight blocks unsafe apply when the source repo is dirty, source `HEAD` differs from `base_ref`, the patch hash does not match metadata, or `git apply --check` fails.
tasks.prompt:
GOALS: Worktree merge preflight blocks unsafe apply when the source repo is dirty, source `HEAD` differs from `base_ref`, the patch hash does not match metadata, or `git apply --check` fails.

Harden `agent_runner/gitops.py` pending worktree merge handling. Record a patch hash in new pending metadata, preserve compatibility by treating older missing-hash pending markers as unsafe for automated web merge, and add preflight checks before apply: source repo must be clean, source HEAD must match `base_ref`, patch hash must match metadata, and `git apply --check --binary` must pass. Surface preflight failures through CLI/web action responses without applying the patch or deleting pending files. Update caller behavior and tests for success, dirty source, HEAD mismatch, hash mismatch, and apply-check failure.
tasks.done_when: Unsafe worktree merge attempts fail before `git apply`, leave source files untouched, keep pending review visible, return actionable preflight messages, and focused unit/API tests cover all required block conditions plus the happy path.

Improve worktree cleanup in `agent_runner/gitops.py` for Windows locked-path behavior. Ensure `agent_runner/web.py` and `web_console/app.js` keep cleanup-failed states visible as recoverable warnings until a later status artifact or reconciliation clears them. Add tests simulating cleanup failures and verifying exact path/message propagation.

tasks.prompt:
GOALS: Shell, web, and remote-controller starts create a new `run_dir` by default; latest run reuse requires explicit resume or `--run-dir` intent.

Change run-dir selection so shell starts, web runner-control starts, and `RunnerController` starts create a fresh `run_dir` unless `--run-dir`, explicit resume, or an explicit resume-latest control option is supplied. Remove implicit latest-run reuse caused only by `loop`, `continuous`, or `autopilot`. Keep true resume flows working and visible in status payloads. Update UI copy if a resume option is exposed. tasks.prompt:
GOALS: `STATE.json` done/failed counts are scoped to the current backlog generation so stale task ids from previous backlogs cannot inflate progress or history.

Scope `STATE.json` done, failed, skipped, progress, and history counts to the active backlog generation/task ids. Fix any failed-count paths that still count stale ids from previous backlogs.
